notes: Seven previously uncontacted technical recruiting founders with Hunter-valid company-domain emails.
No URLs or tracking links are included. Recipients can find Hirelix through Google when the need is relevant.
The copy introduces what Hirelix provides without asking for a JD, trial task, reply, or product feedback.
Every email states the business relevance and includes an opt-out plus mailing-address placeholder.
Final sending requires recipient and copy confirmation plus configured sender and postal address.

emails.subject: AI sourcing and screening for Scale-Ability
emails.body:
Hi Neil,

I'm Noah, founder of Hirelix. We built it for technical recruiters who want to spend less time on repetitive sourcing and initial profile review.

Hirelix turns a role brief into a ranked pool of real technical profiles, with evidence behind each match, risks worth checking, and editable outreach drafts. It helps recruiters get to a credible starting pool faster while keeping judgment and candidate relationships in their hands.

Scale-Ability's focus on AI/ML and software roles made me think it could be useful when a hard-to-fill search comes up.

If that need is on your radar, you can Google "Hirelix AI recruiting" and take a look whenever useful.

Best,
Noah

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
